name: girvan_newman
author: 80ae2fd8
description: Detects communities in an undirected graph using the Girvan-Newman algorithm. Repeatedly removes an edge with maximum edge betweenness centrality to split the graph into communities. Supports top_k to limit returned communities and displayed node references, and num_communities to set the target number of communities. Weighted graphs are treated as unweighted.

graph_id.description: ID of the undirected graph to analyse.

top_k.description: Maximum number of communities to return and maximum number of node references to display per community.

num_communities.description: Target number of communities to detect.
